text:
jade: Heads-up  flying into YVR for the conference. Anyone taken the SkyTrain + Canada Line into downtown? Any gotchas with luggage? :train:
leo: Yep. Canada Line is great. Buy an ORCA/translink day pass at the kiosk or use tap card in the app. stairs at some stations can be tight so aim for off-peak if you have big roller bags.
mina: If youre arriving on a red-eye, look for the porters outside arrivals  theyll handle bags and it's usually tip-based cash (~$5-10). For solo travelers, a lightweight roller + backpack makes the train transfer way easier.
oliver: Quick checklist for YVR arrival:
```
- eTA/visa check before landing
- have credit card + small CAD cash for taxis/porters
- download transit app (Transit or Google Maps offline area)
- pre-load Tap card or use contactless bank card
- if big luggage, consider a short taxi for comfort (~$30-40 downtown)
```
mina: SIM situation: local eSIM worked for me (cheap data) and avoids awkward SIM swaps. But roaming can be fine for short trips if you check rates.
jade: Any late-night food options near the hotel? We land 11pm.
leo: Lots of 24/7 spots in Gastown/Robson have late eats, but double-check the exact block. Room service is a safe bet if youre wiped.
oliver: Weather note: coastal, can be drizzly. lightweight packable rain layer + waterproof shoes are handy.
travel-bot: Reminder: book airport transfers and any ride-share invoices through the company travel portal to ensure policy coverage. Save receipts for expense submission.
mina: If you want to treat yourself after a long flight: grab a quick stretch + coffee, then walk a block to get fresh air. Jetlag-proof strategy: brightest light exposure in morning at your destination.
jade: Team dinner logistics  should we pick one central spot or let folks roam?
leo: central spot is easier. pick somewhere within walking distance of the hotel and make a reservation for 10-12 people. call ahead for group seating.
jade: Cool. I'll spin up a Doodle for preferred nights and look for a place with veggie + gluten options. Thanks y'all  saved this thread. :thumbsup:
